item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 21/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure is expected to form over central China. It will move across the coast of southern China between Monday night and Tuesday morning and bring thundery showers to the region. The associated easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea.

Date/Month: 22/05 (Monday)
Wind: South to southwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers. A few thunderstorms at night.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
